title: RunDoc
description: The execution trace the interpreter emits and the UI consumes per step — the formal contract behind finalized.html's STAGES array. It embeds the visual program verbatim (validate it against dsl.schema.json) and adds one trace entry per step with the EVIDENCE-panel readout (producer / input / output / confidence, D-DR2), normalized overlay boxes (overlay-normalized-stills), per-step status incl. diagnostic-empty (D-DR5), and provenance (live | cached | pinned) for demo honesty. The interpreter replays this with zero live calls on the hero path (D1).

query.description: The canned question being answered, verbatim.

program.description: The DSL program, verbatim. Validate separately against dsl.schema.json.

trace.description: One entry per program step, in execution order. trace[i].id MUST equal program[i].id.

program_source.description: Provenance of the PROGRAM itself (distinct from per-step result `source`): `live` = compiled this run by Azure OpenAI codegen and validated; `pinned` = the known-good fallback program (no codegen creds, or the live program failed validation/execution — D-DR6); `ungrounded` = a free-text query that could not be grounded (no codegen creds, codegen/execution error, invalid program, or no grounded answer) and was NOT substituted with the hero program (Q1→A honesty). Surfaced to the UI for demo honesty.

box.description: Axis-aligned box in normalized 0-1 coords (x,y = top-left).

label.description: e.g. 'read_text -> 10' (D-DR2: evidence labeled by producing step).

tone.description: Maps to functional status colors (D-DR9). azure=detection, teal=active focus, green=found/answer, amber=running, dim=de-emphasized.

id.description: Must equal the program step id this result is for.

producer.description: Human label of the primitive, for the EVIDENCE readout 'Producer step'.

status.description: done=produced evidence; empty=ran, no match (D-DR5 diagnostic empty); error=failed step; pending/active for live streaming.

source.description: Provenance for demo honesty: live=real call this run; cached=precomputed real Azure output; pinned=hand-verified value (e.g. the hero #10 OCR).

inputs.description: Binding ids consumed (for the readout 'Input (from prior step)').

output_label.description: Short human summary for the readout 'Output' (e.g. '10', '5 people').

output.description: Optional structured output value (shape depends on op).

note.description: Diagnostic text for empty/error states (D-DR5: what was searched + why empty).

findings.description: The grounded verdict OR the honest 'couldn't ground this' state (Q1→A). `grounded:false` carries a fixed `reason` enum with null answer/verdict — never a fabricated placeholder. `partial` (weakly grounded — answer rests on partial evidence) is a DISTINCT axis from `grounded` (couldn't ground at all) and is not overloaded for the ungrounded state.

answer.description: Short answer, e.g. 'Yes'. Null when ungrounded (grounded:false).

verdict.description: Full sentence, e.g. 'Yes — #10 scored the first goal'. Null when ungrounded.

supporting_step.description: Trace id of the step whose evidence proves the answer.

partial.description: True if some steps were empty and the answer rests on partial evidence. Distinct from `grounded`.

grounded.description: Q1→A discriminator: true = an evidence-grounded answer was produced; false = the interpreter could not ground an answer (free-text honesty).

reason.description: When grounded:false, a fixed enum explaining why (codegen-disabled, codegen-error, invalid-program, execution-error, no-grounded-answer, answer-not-synthesizable, no-answer-step). Null otherwise. Never raw exception text.
